summary: HR Manager with over a decade of progressive experience in employee relations, compensation, and labor compliance, primarily within a mid-size regional firm. Skilled at aligning HR strategy with business goals while resolving complex staffing and policy issues.

experience.title: HR Manager
bullets: Serve as primary link between management and employees, handling questions, interpreting contracts, and resolving work-related problems across 400+ staff.
Plan, direct, and supervise HR staff activities covering employment, compensation, labor relations, and employee relations.
Advise managers on equal employment opportunity, sexual harassment, and other organizational policy matters, recommending changes that reduced employee grievances by 18%.
Negotiate and administer bargaining agreements, representing the organization at personnel-related hearings and investigations.

experience.title: Senior HR Generalist
bullets: Performed difficult staffing duties, including addressing understaffing, refereeing disputes, and administering disciplinary procedures and terminations.
Analyzed and modified compensation and benefits policies to establish competitive programs and ensure legal compliance, improving retention by 12%.
Conducted new employee orientation to foster positive attitude toward organizational objectives, onboarding over 150 new hires.

experience.title: HR Generalist
bullets: Supported employee relations by interpreting and administering HR contracts and resolving workplace concerns.
Assisted in planning and conducting new employee orientation and coordinating employment and compensation activities.
Maintained compliance with labor regulations and prepared documentation for personnel-related hearings.

experience.title: HR Coordinator
bullets: Coordinated employment, compensation, and employee relations activities under HR management supervision.
Maintained personnel records and supported disciplinary and dispute resolution processes.
Helped administer benefits programs and ensured compliance with legal requirements.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Human Resources Management
